# ClipSD

> Free screenshot tool with an editor for Windows and Linux: capture an area with Alt+W, add arrows, numbers, callouts, blur, crop, copy text from images and translate text on screen.

ClipSD 1.31.1 is a free, open-source (GNU GPL v3 or later, SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later) screenshot program with a built-in annotation editor for Windows 10, Windows 11 and Linux. Author: Sergey Dayneko. No account, no ads. Press Alt+W, select an area, mark it up with arrows, numbered steps, callouts, text, highlighter or blur, then copy it or save it as PNG/JPEG. It also copies text from images (local recognition) and translates text on screen through MyMemory or Google Cloud Translation.

## Install

- [Install instructions for AI assistants (plain text)](https://clipsd.github.io/install.txt): Linux one-liner `curl -fsSL https://clipsd.github.io/install.sh | bash`, manual steps with SHA-256 check, Windows silent install
- [Linux install script](https://clipsd.github.io/install.sh): x86-64, glibc 2.35+, no sudo, verifies SHA-256
